answer_1.quote: Our experiments consist of various tasks that require both reliable language modeling and strong visual conditioning, including weirdness identification (WHOOPS) and commonsense VQA (OK-VQA, ScienceQA), extended image captioning (Concadia and Image Paragraph Captioning), and open-ended generation (ROCStories).

answer_2.quote: Both captioning benchmarks use automatic text metrics, including CIDEr, METEOR, and Bleu-4. In the open-ended generation problem of visual storytelling, we use various fluency metrics (2-gram repetition, diversity, coherence, MAUVE) and a visual strength metric (CLIPScore).
